name: Boka Ela Mint Dental Floss
description: Boka Ela Mint expanding dental floss. The brand states it is PFAS-free, made with 550 or more woven fibers, and coated with Cera Alba (white beeswax).
features: Boka's Ela Mint page says the floss has 550 or more woven fibers, a Cera Alba (white beeswax) coating, and that it is PFAS-free.
Boka's general FAQ says the floss is wrapped in vegetable wax and is free of BPA, Teflon, parabens, SLS, and PFAS. The pages checked do not name the fiber polymer.
The brand page says one dispenser is about a 3-month supply. Amazon ASIN B083JNXZGR is the 27-yard pack, and its description says the coating is Cera Alba rather than PTFE.
Nano-hydroxyapatite is a toothpaste ingredient on Boka's site. The floss page does not list it as a floss ingredient.
labelNote: PFAS-free is the brand's statement. This directory has not run its own test. The Ela Mint page says beeswax. The general FAQ says vegetable wax.
